blocks.heading: Claude cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Claude against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (enterprise admin and SSO (Free, Pro (annual), Pro (monthly), Max, Team Standard (annual), Team Standard (monthly))) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, reasoning / advanced models, writing and paraphrasing) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Free tier usage caps limit heavy document and coding workflows. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
